strategies.label: Triangular Arb

steps.action: Pre-synthesizes swap route off-chain: pool A → pool B → pool C
flashLoan(asset, amount, callback, params)
Transfer amount to receiver contract
executeOperation(): swap A→B on DEX1
executeOperation(): swap B→C on DEX2
executeOperation(): swap C→A on DEX3 (must return ≥ amount + fee)
Pull (amount + fee) from receiver; revert entire tx if underfunded

strategies.aiConstraint: The full swap route must be computed and encoded before the transaction is submitted. The agent cannot react to mid-execution price moves.

strategies.label: Collateral Swap

steps.action: Pre-determines: swap ETH collateral → wBTC collateral on Aave V3
flashLoan(wBTC, debt_amount)
Transfer wBTC to agent contract
executeOperation(): supply wBTC to Aave, borrow ETH against it
executeOperation(): repay existing ETH debt, withdraw ETH collateral
executeOperation(): swap ETH → wBTC to repay flash loan
Pull (wBTC + fee); if balance short → revert all state changes

strategies.aiConstraint: All Aave state transitions (supply, borrow, repay, withdraw) must be choreographed in a single callback. The agent cannot pause to re-evaluate after each step.

strategies.label: Self-Liquidation

steps.action: Detects own position approaching liquidation threshold
flashLoan(debt_token, outstanding_debt)
Transfer debt_token to agent contract
executeOperation(): repay full debt on lending protocol
executeOperation(): withdraw 100% of collateral (no liquidation penalty)
executeOperation(): sell enough collateral to repay flash loan + fee
Pull (debt_token + fee); agent keeps remaining collateral

strategies.aiConstraint: Timing is everything — the agent must recognize when self-liquidation costs less than the liquidator's bonus before a bot does it first.

economics.note: At $1M borrow on Aave V3: fee = $500 (0.05%), typical complex arb gas ≈ $12 at 20 gwei on L2. Break-even spread = (500 + 12) / 1,000,000 = 0.0512%

historicalContext.source: Euler Finance post-mortem, Chainalysis 2023 DeFi report
